title: The Cancellation Ladder, Administration Amount and Deposit Treatment Recorded for Each Package Product
content:
Each of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products records a cancellation ladder keyed by how far ahead of departure a cancellation lands, an administration charge per traveller, and whether the deposit itself is recorded as returnable.

## The cancellation ladder, as a share of the package price

| Product | 90 or more days before departure | 89 to 43 days | 42 to 15 days | 14 or fewer days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 25 per cent | 50 per cent | 75 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Flex Bundle Package | 15 per cent | 35 per cent | 60 per cent | 100 per cent |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 20 per cent | 45 per cent | 70 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Escorted Tour Package | 25 per cent | 55 per cent | 80 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 30 per cent | 60 per cent | 85 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Luxury Collection Package | 10 per cent | 30 per cent | 55 per cent | 90 per cent |

## Administration charge and deposit treatment

| Product | Administration charge per traveller | Deposit recorded as returnable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 75.00 USD | no |
| Flex Bundle Package | 60.00 USD | no |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 75.00 USD | no |
| Escorted Tour Package | 100.00 USD | no |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 125.00 USD | no |
| Luxury Collection Package | 50.00 USD | yes |

## Reading the bands

The bands are counted in whole days lying between the cancellation and the departure date, and they meet without a gap: a cancellation 90 days ahead falls in the first band, one 89 days ahead in the second, one 43 days ahead in the second, one 42 days ahead in the third, one 15 days ahead in the third, and one 14 days ahead in the fourth. The Luxury Collection Package is the only product in the range whose deposit is recorded as returnable, and the only one whose last band is recorded below 100 per cent, at 90 per cent.
